description: Encoding.Tuple.pack/1 (tuple.ex:44-45) wraps top-level lists in nested-list tag 0x06...0x00, so pack(["app"]) is not a prefix of pack(["app","users"]) (diverges at terminator vs next-element byte). do_list/do_remove/do_move_recursive build ranges via KeyRange.from_prefix on the packed parent key -> non-root list returns [], remove orphans descendants, move misses them. Root works only because NodeKey.pack([]) = <<>>. Masked by canned Mox get_range mocks in all existing directory tests; no integration path exercises non-root hierarchy ops. Fix: pack path elements unwrapped (FDB subspace semantics) in NodeKey.pack — needs data-migration story for existing node keys. Then convert canned-mock directory tests to the real-store harness from directory_partition_test.exs so descendant behavior is actually asserted. Audit-confirmed in PR for bedrock-ej0.
title: Directory node keys are not byte-prefixes of children; non-root list/remove/move broken vs real store
